Welcome! This site collects my research on microbial fossilization, my publications, a web
version of my CV, and photos from fieldwork. It is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org)
and hosted on GitHub Pages. Try the moon/sun toggle in the top bar to switch between dark
and light mode.
